name: Box
desc: Axis-aligned box centered on x,y with its base at z

name: Cylinder
desc: Cylinder starting at x,y,z going along axis

name: Sphere
desc: Solid ball centered on x, y, z with radius r

name: Cone
desc: Cone or truncated cone from base radius r1 to top radius r2 over height h along the axis (r2 of 0 gives a sharp tip)

name: Torus
desc: Ring with ring radius r1 (center of the tube) and tube radius r2, centered on x, y, z

name: Extrude
desc: 2D profile on a plane pushed along the plane normal

name: Revolve
desc: 2D profile spun around the sketch x or y axis (profile must stay on one side of the axis)

name: Hole
desc: Drills into the part from the sketch plane, against its normal.

name: Loft
desc: Blends between 2+ profiles stacked along the plane normal.

name: Sweep
desc: Pushes a 2D profile (centered on 0,0) along a 3D polyline path with rounded bends.

name: Coil spring
desc: Helical coil spring of round wire

name: Thread
desc: Unified (UNC/UNF) or ISO metric 60° modeled thread.

name: Split / trim
desc: Cuts the part with a plane and keeps one side

name: Scale
desc: Resizes the part by a factor, uniformly or per axis, about a point

name: Fillet
desc: Rounds the chosen edges with radius r.

name: Chamfer
desc: Bevels the selected edges.

name: Shell
desc: Hollows the part inward, removing the open faces

name: Pattern
desc: Copies earlier solid/cut/hole features (or, with body true, the whole part).

name: Mirror
desc: Adds a mirrored copy of the whole part.

name: Move
desc: Moves (or with copy true, copies) the whole part by dx,dy,dz and rotates it angle degrees about axis (X|Y|Z, a direction [x,y,z] or the id of a datum_…

name: Molding
desc: A wood molding: the profile cross-section (casing, base, crown, chair rail, or any edge or groove profile as a stock cross-section) pushed along +X fo…

name: Edge profile
desc: Cuts a library edge profile (roundover, cove, chamfer, ogee, bead, rabbet, panel edges and more) along straight 90 degree edges of a part, like a rout…

name: Router bit
desc: A carbide-tipped router bit built from a profile.

name: Shaper cutter
desc: A shaper cutterhead with wings that follow the profile.

name: Molder knife
desc: A planer-molder knife blank ground with the molding profile corrected for the cutting circle, hook angle and projection (the knife profile is not the …

name: Draft
desc: Tilts faces for moulding or casting so the part pulls out of the mould.

name: Rib
desc: A rib or gusset: an open line (pts, 2+ points in sketch coordinates on the sketch plane) is thickened to t across the plane (side both = centered on t…

name: Combine bodies
desc: Merges, subtracts or intersects separate bodies of the part (a part has several bodies when an added feature does not touch it, or when op new keeps o…

name: Datum plane
desc: A reference plane that builds no geometry.

name: Datum axis
desc: A reference axis that builds no geometry.

name: Datum point
desc: A reference point that builds no geometry.

name: Sketch profiles
desc: The 2D shapes a sketch feature can use: rectangle, circle, polygon, slot, polyline, text, ellipse, spline (closed), airfoil.

name: Fan
desc: Axial fan: hub, N twisted airfoil blades (chord taper and pitch twist), optional tip shroud ring, bore with optional keyway and set screw

name: Propeller
desc: Propeller: small hub and a few high-pitch tapered airfoil blades, bore with optional keyway and set screw

name: Impeller
desc: Centrifugal impeller.

name: Gear
desc: Spur gear with a true involute tooth profile (full depth, 1.0 m addendum, 1.25 m dedendum), parametric in teeth, module and pressure angle.

name: Sprocket
desc: ANSI roller chain sprocket.

name: Heat sink
desc: Heat sink: base plate with plate fins (count and pitch are parameters) or a grid of pin fins, optional corner mounting holes.

name: Flange
desc: Bolt-circle flange: disc, hub, centre bore, N bolt holes on a bolt circle (count is a parameter)

name: Pillow block
desc: Pillow block bearing housing.
